name: Pearson症候群

summary.text: A rare mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation disorder due to large-scale single deletion of mitochondrial DNA characterized by hyporegenerative anemia in early infancy with vacuolization of bone marrow precursors, lactic acidosis and multi-organ dysfunctions such as exocrine pancreatic dysfunction, and renal tubulopathy.
